messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-2 — GPU OOMs observed during prefill on cluster gpu-pool-eu-west. Multiple containers restarted in the last 2m. Affected service: runtime-prefill, ~3% request failures / increased latency. Paging oncall: @ryan.oncall
ryan.oncall: Acked. joining. any customer hits?
csm-julia: FYI: a few customers on Dedicated reported streaming disconnects ~1:23 UTC, possible impact to longer-context requests.
maya-sre: Looking at node logs — seeing repeated OOM kill for container runtime-prefill-v2 on node gpu-eu-12. Kernel message: "Out of memory: Kill process 4532 (runtime)".
pranav-eng: Any pattern on prompt length or window?
maya-sre: Early signal: prefill token distribution spikes at ~120k tokens for some requests (long-chat import). Probably long context + batch prefill.
ryan.oncall: Immediate mitigations: 1) Disable prefetch/prefill for long-window routes 2) Temporarily route large-context traffic to coldmodel fallback 3) Increase eviction aggressiveness on kvcache. Who can flip routing?
pranav-eng: I can deploy a routing rule change to send >50k token requests to coldmodel-fallback in the next 2m. Will do a canary to 10% first.
ops-bot: Deploy started: routing-service v3.2 -> canary to 10% (ID: deploy-8043210010).
ryan.oncall: While that rolls, please run `kubectl cordon gpu-eu-12` and drain low-priority pods. If node is unhealthy we may need to reboot.
maya-sre: Running cordon/drain now. Command:```
kubectl cordon gpu-eu-12
kubectl drain gpu-eu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
ops-bot: cordon/drain reported 3 restart failures, evicting with grace 0.
pranav-eng: Canary routing applied. Observing 60% reduction in OOMs on gpu-eu-12 within 30s.
csm-julia: Notifying affected customers: short note drafted and sent to support with mitigation steps and ETA.
ryan.oncall: Good. Next: can we reduce per-request prefetch batch size or disable batching on heavy routes?
maya-sre: Yes, lowering batch size for prefill to 0.5x for hostgroups serving long-context. Patching config now: `prefill.batch_size: 32 -> 16`
pranav-eng: Patch applied to hostgroup pref-llarge. Observed decreased memory footprint on new containers.
ryan.oncall: Any sign of CUDA errors (driver resets) or is it pure OOM?
maya-sre: Mostly OOMs, but one container showed `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` after OOM — likely secondary. We'll keep an eye.
ops-bot: node gpu-eu-12 reboot scheduled (manual) by maya-sre at 8043210300.
pranav-eng: Suggest adding a short circuit: reject prefill requests larger than 200k tokens with a 413 and guidance to chunk. Could ship as quick fix.
yan.oncall: (typo) -- ignore
ryan.oncall: @pranav-eng please open shortfix PR for 413 response and doc blurb.
pranav-eng: PR opened: github.com/redwood/runtime/pulls/8123 — includes 413 enforcement and telemetry.
csm-julia: Customers asked for ETA — current remediation shows degraded streaming for ~15m, mitigations in place, will follow up with a customer-impact update.
maya-sre: Post-mitigation metrics: OOM restart rate down from 8/min to ~0.5/min across cluster. Latency for long-context routes slowly recovering.
ryan.oncall: OK. Prepare handoff: I'm going offline in 20m. @maya-sre you take next oncall. Please monitor for any regressions and escalate if OOMs spike >2/min.
maya-sre: Taking handoff. Will keep routing rule canary at 10% for 10m then increase to 50% if stable.
ops-bot: Handoff recorded: oncall -> maya-sre at 8043210540.
pranav-eng: Follow-up actions: 1) investigate why prefill batch wasn't adaptive to request token count 2) add per-request token caps in router 3) improve observability on per-token memory delta.
ryan.oncall: Thanks team. Posting incident summary and timeline in #incidents once stable. :thumbsup:
